# Chapter 1: The Inventory

The rain had not stopped since Tuesday. Delia Foss unlocked the records room at half past six and found the lamp already burning.

Emmett Rourke was asleep in the reading chair with a ledger open across his chest. Delia Foss shook him once by the shoulder. Emmett Rourke did not stir at all.

"Get up," she said. "Do you know what hour it is?"

He blinked at her without much conviction. "I'm not asleep. I'm resting my eyes between counts."

The ledger had been countersigned by Halloran in March, and countersigned again by Halloran in April. Delia Foss had never once met Halloran. Nobody else in the building would admit to having met Halloran either.

"You're going to tell me who Halloran is," she said. "Don't pretend you haven't wondered about it yourself."

Emmett Rourke closed the ledger with more care than it deserved. "The March entries are... incomplete on purpose. Somebody wanted them left that way."

She wrote the date on her cuff because there was no paper she trusted. Outside, the rain kept on at the high windows.
